mapper.select: SELECT request_id, policy_number, request_reason, source_id, underwriting_type, request_status, underwriting_result, rejection_reason, surcharge_condition, requested_at, completed_at, cancelled_at FROM contract_underwriting_request WHERE request_id = #{requestId}

SELECT request_id, policy_number, request_reason, source_id, underwriting_type, request_status, underwriting_result, rejection_reason, surcharge_condition, requested_at, completed_at, cancelled_at FROM contract_underwriting_request WHERE source_id = #{sourceId} ORDER BY requested_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE contract_underwriting_request SET request_status = 'COMPLETED', underwriting_result = #{underwritingResult}, rejection_reason = #{rejectionReason}, surcharge_condition = #{surchargeCondition}, completed_at = #{completedAt} WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND request_status = 'PENDING'
